scope: Two complete local static contracts; no execution oracle, full disk compatibility or transitive I/O contract

abi.convention: cdecl supported by plain RET and caller cleanup

functions.total: T=low32(size*count); zero returns zero without stream/destination dereference
functions.buffered_path: WORD flags +0xc intersects 0x10c and DWORD availability +4 !=0: K=min_unsigned(remaining,availability); call copy-shaped 0094ab50(dest,[stream],K); decrement remaining/availability and advance both pointers by K
functions.direct_path: remaining>=unsigned quantum; quantum=+18 if flagged else initially 4096; N=remaining-(remaining%quantum), or remaining if quantum zero; call 0094b3e0([stream+10],dest,N)
functions.direct_result: 0 ORs DWORD +0xc with 0x10 and stops; -1 ORs with 0x20 and stops; every other DWORD advances dest and subtracts from remaining unchecked
functions.single_byte_path: remaining<unsigned quantum: call 0094b307(stream); -1 stops; otherwise store AL, advance one, reload quantum from DWORD +18
functions.return: remaining==0 returns original raw count; stopped transfer unsigned-divides low32(T-remaining) by size
functions.failure_limit: Partial destination/stream changes persist; no positive/result<=request check on lower direct read, no rollback or rewind; lower helper error/position effects unresolved

functions.bound: B=low32(size*count); C=DWORD +8; L=unaligned DWORD at +low32((DWORD +c)*0x10c)+0x29; if C>signed low32(L-B), B=low32(L-C) and return 0 if B<=signed0
functions.position: Store low32(C+B) at DWORD +8 before mode test/I/O
functions.mode_selection: unaligned DWORD +19 exactly 4 selects byte-run decoder; every other value selects whole-item delegation
functions.other_mode: J=signed_trunc(B/size); +8=low32(C+size*J), then 00945bfe(dest,size,J,[stream]); forward EAX. Position is not corrected after short read
functions.mode4: Emit B bytes for positive signed B, retain pending repeats, return signed_trunc(B/size); nonpositive B skips output but still divides
functions.refill: 00945bfe(stream+0x41705,1,200000,[stream]); store EAX fill count; read buffer[0] and set cursor=1 without testing result
functions.signedness: All custom bounds/cursor comparisons and IDIV are signed; token split is unsigned; arithmetic wraps at 32 bits
functions.failure_limit: Size zero can divide by zero after position update; mode4 refill zero can use stale/uninitialized byte; decoder does not propagate refill failure; partial-item output and optimistic position persist

caller_relationship: R14/R15 full caller mode DWORD zero selects 00945bfe, nonzero selects 00932c30. This outer mode is not passed into either helper. R14 checks exact item count; R15 accepts any nonzero raw helper result

direct_dependencies.boundary: (dest,cached_pointer,K); return ignored; complete body/overlap behavior unresolved
([stream+10],dest,N); result interpreted as byte count, zero or -1; complete I/O/position/translation behavior unresolved
(stream); -1 or AL byte; refill and flag/position changes unresolved
Two byte refills and one whole-item delegation

ownership: Borrow stream and destination. No direct heap allocation/free, open/close, RNG or explicit global access. Lower helper effects remain unresolved
limits: No full database/save schema or file compatibility
No recovered stream constructor, capacity/lifetime or valid input corpus
No physical-position equivalence to logical or encoded cursors
No malformed-input safety or runtime equivalence claim
